title: Delegated Administration Roles Semantic Contract
description: Deferred semantic contract for delegated administration roles. React documents this capability (ADR and delegated-capability-permissions evidence), but its behavioural source (usecases, tests, migration) is not yet in the USF source-import manifest, so facets remain gaps. Closing it requires importing those source rows (USF-74) before source-backed facets can be authored.
aiGuidance: Do not treat this deferred gap contract as implementation authority. Before implementation use, replace gap facets with reviewed source-backed semantic content, source-use row membership, and proof expectations.
